info.title: Mailchimp Marketing API (curated real subset)
info.description: Curated subset (2 operations) extracted verbatim from the real published Swagger 2.0 document at https://api.mailchimp.com/schema/3.0/Swagger.json, converted to OpenAPI 3 shape (body/formData parameters folded into requestBody, response `schema` wrapped in `content`) — every field, description and constraint below is copied from the upstream document, only the envelope changed. 0 expandable-resource unions collapsed, 0 other unions stubbed. No schema hit the depth/size cap.

post.description: Add a new member to the list.

default.description: An error generated by the Mailchimp API.

post.description: Send a Mailchimp campaign. For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule. All other campaigns will send immediately.

default.description: An error generated by the Mailchimp API.

Parameters_ListID.name: list_id
Parameters_ListID.description: The unique ID for the list.

Parameters_SkipMergeValidation.name: skip_merge_validation
Parameters_SkipMergeValidation.description: If skip_merge_validation is true, member data will be accepted without merge field values, even if the merge field is usually required. This defaults to false.

Members_Response.title: List Members
Members_Response.description: Individuals who are currently or have been previously subscribed to this list, including members who have bounced or unsubscribed.

id.title: Email ID
id.description: The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member's email address.

unique_email_id.title: Unique Email ID
unique_email_id.description: An identifier for the address across all of Mailchimp.

contact_id.title: Contact ID
contact_id.description: As Mailchimp evolves beyond email, you may eventually have contacts without email addresses. While the `id` is the MD5 hash of their email address, this `contact_id` is agnostic of contact’s inclusion of an email address.

web_id.title: Member Web ID
web_id.description: The ID used in the Mailchimp web application. View this member in your Mailchimp account at `https://{dc}.admin.mailchimp.com/lists/members/view?id={web_id}`.

email_type.title: Email Type
email_type.description: Type of email this member asked to get ('html' or 'text').

consents_to_one_to_one_messaging.title: Messaging Consent
consents_to_one_to_one_messaging.description: Indicates whether a contact consents to 1:1 messaging.

sms_phone_number.title: SMS Phone Number
sms_phone_number.description: A US phone number for SMS contact.

sms_subscription_status.title: SMS Subscription Status
sms_subscription_status.description: The status of an SMS subscription.

sms_subscription_last_updated.title: SMS Subscription Last Update
sms_subscription_last_updated.description: The datetime when the SMS subscription was last updated

interests.title: Subscriber Interests
interests.description: The key of this object's properties is the ID of the interest in question.

additionalProperties.title: Interest Value
additionalProperties.description: Keys are interest IDs, values are booleans that describe whether the list member is in that group or not.

stats.title: Subscriber Stats
stats.description: Open and click rates for this subscriber.

ecommerce_data.title: Ecommerce Stats
ecommerce_data.description: Ecommerce stats for the list member if the list is attached to a store.

total_revenue.title: Total Revenue
total_revenue.description: The total revenue the list member has brought in.

number_of_orders.title: Total Number of Orders
number_of_orders.description: The total number of orders placed by the list member.

currency_code.title: Currency
currency_code.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 code for the currency that the store accepts.

ip_signup.title: Signup IP
ip_signup.description: IP address the subscriber signed up from.

timestamp_signup.title: Signup Timestamp
timestamp_signup.description: The date and time the subscriber signed up for the list in ISO 8601 format.

ip_opt.title: Opt-in IP
ip_opt.description: The IP address the subscriber used to confirm their opt-in status.

timestamp_opt.title: Opt-in Timestamp
timestamp_opt.description: The date and time the subscriber confirmed their opt-in status in ISO 8601 format.

member_rating.title: Member Rating
member_rating.description: Star rating for this member, between 1 and 5.

last_changed.title: Last Changed Date
last_changed.description: The date and time the member's info was last changed in ISO 8601 format.

gmtoff.title: GMT Offset
gmtoff.description: The time difference in hours from GMT.

dstoff.title: DST Offset
dstoff.description: The offset for timezones where daylight saving time is observed.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: The unique code for the location country.

marketing_permissions.title: Marketing Permissions
marketing_permissions.description: The marketing permissions for the subscriber.

items.title: Marketing Permission
items.description: A single marketing permission a subscriber has either opted-in to or opted-out of.

marketing_permission_id.title: Marketing Permission ID
marketing_permission_id.description: The id for the marketing permission on the list

text.title: Marketing Permission Text
text.description: The text of the marketing permission.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: If the subscriber has opted-in to the marketing permission.

last_note.title: Notes
last_note.description: The most recent Note added about this member.

created_at.title: Created Time
created_at.description: The date and time the note was created in ISO 8601 format.

source.title: Subscriber Source
source.description: The source from which the subscriber was added to this list.

tags_count.title: Tags Count
tags_count.description: The number of tags applied to this member.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Returns up to 50 tags applied to this member. To retrieve all tags see [Member Tags](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/list-member-tags/).

Responses_ServerError.title: Problem Detail Document
Responses_ServerError.description: An error generated by the Mailchimp API. Conforms to IETF draft 'draft-nottingham-http-problem-06'.

type.title: Problem Type
type.description: An absolute URI that identifies the problem type. When dereferenced, it should provide human-readable documentation for the problem type.

title.title: Error Title
title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It shouldn't change based on the occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

status.title: HTTP Status Code
status.description: The HTTP status code (RFC2616, Section 6) generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.title: Error Message
detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. [Learn more about errors](/developer/guides/get-started-with-mailchimp-api-3/#Errors).
detail.example: The requested resource could not be found.

instance.title: Instance ID
instance.description: A string that identifies this specific occurrence of the problem. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

Members_MergeFieldsDict.title: Merge Fields
Members_MergeFieldsDict.description: A dictionary of merge fields where the keys are the merge tags. See the [Merge Fields documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/merge-fields/#structure) for more about the structure.

additionalProperties.description: This object's keys are merge tags (like FNAME). It's values are the values to be added to the merge field.

Definitions_HATEOASLinks.title: Links
Definitions_HATEOASLinks.description: A list of link types and descriptions for the API schema documents.

items.title: Resource Link
items.description: This object represents a link from the resource where it is found to another resource or action that may be performed.

rel.title: Rel
rel.description: As with an HTML 'rel' attribute, this describes the type of link.

href.title: Href
href.description: This property contains a fully-qualified URL that can be called to retrieve the linked resource or perform the linked action.

method.title: Method
method.description: The HTTP method that should be used when accessing the URL defined in 'href'.

targetSchema.title: Target Schema
targetSchema.description: For GETs, this is a URL representing the schema that the response should conform to.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: For HTTP methods that can receive bodies (POST and PUT), this is a URL representing the schema that the body should conform to.
